name: Filter — match against a list
description: Branches pass / fail. Pass when the source field matches one of the chosen values. Use 'from ref' on the values port to pick from a reference table (e.g. all airports in a country).

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The text field you want to check — pick one from the request.

params.name: literal
params.description: The values that pass — type your own list (one per line), or use 'From Ref' to pick rows from a reference table.

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source path resolves to multiple values, which element decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one element satisfies the test.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every element satisfies the test.

enum.label: First only
enum.description: Test the first element and ignore the rest.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on without a verdict.
